definition_zh: 自给自足；经济自立；专制统治
definition_en: economic self-sufficiency of a country; also, absolute rule or sovereignty over oneself
core_image: 一个国家闭起门来，靠自己的土地养活自己
scene: 战争阴云下，内阁决议不再依赖进口粮食与燃料。The government pursued autarchy by growing all its own food.
sceneCN: 这里 autarchy 指「经济自给自足」（第 1 个义项：国家层面的自足政策）；句意：政府通过自产全部粮食来追求自给自足。

pos.zh: 自给自足；经济自立；专制

derivatives.zh: 自给自足（同一希腊词的现代经济学通行拼法）

senses.title: Economic self-sufficiency of a state
senses.definition: a policy or condition in which a country produces everything it needs without foreign trade
senses.definitionCN: 一国不依赖外贸而自产所需一切的政策或状态
senses.example: The regime promised autarchy: no imports, no dependence.
senses.exampleCN: 政权许诺自给自足：不进口、不依赖。
senses.why: The Greek roots mean self-rule; applied to economies, ruling oneself meant feeding oneself.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根本义是「自我统治」；用于经济，自我统治便意味着自给自食。

senses.title: Absolute sovereignty; self-rule
senses.definition: complete independence or self-government, the word's original philosophical sense
senses.definitionCN: 完全独立或自我治理，此词最初的哲学义
senses.example: Greek philosophers praised the wise man's autarchy.
senses.exampleCN: 希腊哲学家称颂智者的自足自持。
senses.why: For the Stoics, the self-sufficient man needed nothing outside his own virtue.
senses.whyCN: 在斯多亚学派看来，自足之人无需自身德性之外的任何东西。

senses.title: Absolute rule by one power
senses.definition: unlimited political rule concentrated in one authority
senses.definitionCN: 集中于单一权威的不受限制的政治统治
senses.example: The colony chafed under imperial autarchy.
senses.exampleCN: 殖民地在帝国专制下备受煎熬。
senses.why: Self-rule of one person over others drifts into absolute power; the word carries both.
senses.whyCN: 「自我统治」滑向一人凌驾他人，便成了绝对权力；词义两义并存。

senses.title: Autarky in modern economics
senses.titleCN: 现代经济学中的 autarky 拼法
senses.definition: the same idea written autarky in standard modern economic texts, a closed economy
senses.definitionCN: 同一概念在现代经济学文献中多写作 autarky，指封闭经济
senses.example: Economics textbooks model the no-trade case as autarky.
senses.exampleCN: 经济学教科书把无贸易情形建模为 autarky（自足经济）。
senses.why: The modern science re-borrowed the Greek word directly, creating a rival spelling.
senses.whyCN: 现代学科直接重新借入希腊原词，造成了与旧拼法并立的局面。

senses.title: Wartime self-reliance
senses.definition: self-sufficiency pursued under blockade or war, when trade is cut off
senses.definitionCN: 封锁或战争切断贸易时追求的自给状态
senses.example: Blockade forced the island into autarchy.
senses.exampleCN: 封锁迫使该岛走向自给自足。
senses.why: War makes self-sufficiency a survival strategy, not a doctrine.
senses.whyCN: 战争让自给自足成为生存策略而非教条。

senses.title: Personal self-sufficiency
senses.definition: self-sufficiency of an individual, needing no external help
senses.definitionCN: 个体层面无所外求的自足
senses.example: He lived in quiet autarchy, growing what he ate.
senses.exampleCN: 他自种自食，过着安静的自足生活。
senses.why: The philosophical root reaches from states down to single lives.
senses.whyCN: 哲学词根的意义可以从国家一路下探到个人生活。

senses.title: Autarchy as doctrine
senses.definition: an economic doctrine demanding national self-sufficiency, as in the 1930s
senses.definitionCN: 要求国家自给自足的经济学说，如 20 世纪 30 年代
senses.exampleCN: 大萧条时期的经济规划者一度醉心自足主义。
senses.why: When trade seemed a trap, closing the door looked like safety.
senses.whyCN: 当贸易看似陷阱时，关起门来便显得像安全。

senses.title: Autarchy versus autocracy
senses.definition: distinguished from autocracy, rule by one person, with which it is often confused
senses.definitionCN: 与常被混淆的 autocracy「独裁统治」相区别
senses.example: Autarchy is about self-sufficiency; autocracy is about one ruler.
senses.exampleCN: autarchy 讲自给自足，autocracy 讲一人独裁。
senses.why: The shared auto- misleads: one word rules an economy, the other a people.
senses.whyCN: 共同的 auto- 颇能惑人：一个词管经济，另一个词管人。

intro.en: Autarchy comes from Greek autarkeia, self-sufficiency, from autos, self, plus arkein, to suffice or to rule; Latin carried it as autarchia and English borrowed it in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: autarchy 出自希腊语 autarkeia「自足」，由 autos「自身」加 arkein「满足/统治」构成；拉丁语作 autarchia，17 世纪进入英语。

items.en: The root *nek- meant to reach or to be strong, feeding arkein, to suffice or hold off.
items.cn: 词根 *nek- 意为「到达、强健」，衍生出 arkein「足以应对；抵御」。

items.en: autos meant self and arkein meant to suffice; autarkeia named the self-sufficient person or state.
items.cn: 希腊语 autos 意为「自身」，arkein 意为「满足」；autarkeia 指自足的个人或城邦。

items.en: Stoics and Epicureans made autarkeia an ideal: the sage needs nothing beyond himself.
items.cn: 斯多亚与伊壁鸠鲁学派将 autarkeia 奉为理想：智者无所外求。

items.en: Latin adopted autarchia as a learned borrowing from Greek.
items.cn: 拉丁语以学术借词的形式收下 autarchia。

items.en: English recorded autarchy in the seventeenth century, first in the old sense of absolute sovereignty.
items.cn: 17 世纪英语记录下 autarchy，最初指绝对主权这一旧义。

items.en: Economics re-borrowed the Greek as autarky for closed economies; autarchy keeps the older senses.
items.cn: 经济学以 autarky 重新借入希腊原词指封闭经济；autarchy 则保留较旧的义项。

note.en: Group one collects the auto- family and the rival spellings; group two collects neighboring self-rule and economy words.
note.cn: 第一组收 auto- 词族及并立拼法；第二组收相邻的自治与经济词。

entries.definition: the modern economic spelling of the same Greek word.
entries.definitionCN: 同一希腊词的现代经济学拼法。

entries.definition: rule by one person, from kratos, power; often confused with autarchy.
entries.definitionCN: 独裁统治，出自 kratos「权力」；常与 autarchy 混淆。

entries.definition: self-law, self-government, from nomos, law; related idea, different root.
entries.definitionCN: 自治，出自 nomos「法律」；义相近而词根不同。

entries.definition: rule by one, from monos plus arkhos; shares the rule ending only.
entries.definitionCN: 君主制，出自 monos + arkhos；仅共享「统治」词尾。

entries.definition: rule of none, from an- without; shares only the ending.
entries.definitionCN: 无政府状态，an-「无」+ arkhos；仅共享词尾。

entries.definition: the plain English term for needing nothing from outside.
a policy of avoiding foreign entanglements and trade.
entries.definitionCN: 孤立主义；避免对外纠葛与贸易的政策。

entries.definition: shielding home industry with tariffs; a milder cousin of autarchy.
entries.definitionCN: 保护主义；以关税护内，为 autarchy 的温和近亲。

entries.definition: supreme independent authority of a state.
self-government of a group or person under broader rules.
entries.definitionCN: 在更大框架下的群体或个人自治。

normalIntro.en: autarchy is auto plus archy: self plus rule, once of persons, now of economies.
normalIntro.cn: autarchy = auto + archy：自身 + 统治——从前管人，如今管经济。

normal.cn: auto（自身）+ arkein（满足）：靠自己就够。

normal.en: The -archy ending means rule: monarchy, anarchy, autarchy.
Autarky is the same word wearing an economics textbook's spelling.
normal.cn: autarky 是同一个词换上了经济学教科书的拼法。

normal.en: Do not mix it with autocracy: autarchy feeds itself, autocracy rules alone.
normal.cn: 勿与 autocracy 混淆：autarchy 自给，autocracy 独裁。

normal.en: Think of a country closing its ports and calling it strength.
normal.cn: 想象一个国家关上港口，还称之为强大。

abstract.en: Picture a walled garden that grows every fruit it needs.
abstract.cn: 想象一座果园，墙上所需的水果一应俱全。

abstract.en: Autarchy is the nation as a hermit: self-fed, self-ruled, self-proud.
abstract.cn: autarchy 是隐士式的国家：自养、自治、自傲。

abstract.en: The word stands at the gate, turning back every foreign ship.
abstract.cn: 这个词伫立港口，把每艘外国船挡在门外。

examples.en: Complete autarchy is almost impossible for a modern economy.
examples.cn: 对现代经济体而言，完全自给自足几乎不可能。

examples.en: The philosopher praised autarchy as freedom from desire.
examples.cn: 这位哲学家称颂自足为摆脱欲望束缚的自由。

examples.en: Sanctions pushed the country toward reluctant autarchy.
examples.cn: 制裁迫使该国不情愿地走向自给自足。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥塔基」——阿基住在奥秘塔里，自种自吃，从不外出

root: 出自希腊语 autarkeia「自足」（autos「自身」+ arkein「满足；抵御」），经拉丁语 autarchia 于 17 世纪进入英语；现代经济学以 autarky 拼法直接重新借入希腊原词；与 autocracy（kratos「权力」）词尾相近而根不同，词源确凿。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses span one idea from sage to state: personal self-sufficiency, absolute sovereignty, closed economies, and the spellings and confusions the word collected along the way.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项让一个概念从智者走向国家：个人自足、绝对主权、封闭经济，以及这个词一路积累的拼法与混淆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a state or soul that needs nothing from outside its walls.
core.cn: 核心意象：一国之或一人之心，不求于墙外。

branches.en: THE STATE SIDE: national self-sufficiency in peace and in war.
branches.cn: 国家一面：和平与战争中的自给自足。

branches.en: THE SELF SIDE: the sage's autarchy and the hermit's garden.
branches.cn: 自身一面：智者的自足与隐者的园圃。

branches.en: THE POWER SIDE: absolute rule wearing the same name.
branches.cn: 权力一面：顶着同一名字的绝对统治。

branches.en: THE DOCTRINE SIDE: autarky in textbooks and 1930s plans.
branches.cn: 学说一面：教科书中的 autarky 与 30 年代方案。

branches.en: THE PUZZLE SIDE: autarchy against autocracy.
branches.cn: 谜题一面：autarchy 与 autocracy 之辨。

intro.en: autarchy is autos plus a root meaning suffice or rule; the auto- prefix does the visible work.
intro.cn: autarchy 由 autos 加表「满足/统治」的词根构成；auto- 前缀是可见的主体。

latinIntro.en: Greek autarkeia reached English through Latin autarchia; the rival autarky skipped Latin entirely.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 autarkeia 经拉丁语 autarchia 进入英语；并立拼法 autarky 则完全绕开了拉丁语。
